item.title: Import Graph Data with SeaTunnel Sink
item.description:
SeaTunnel connects data sources such as databases and Kafka to HugeGraph. The connector has two parts: Source reads data and Sink writes data[1][2], with SeaTunnel transform components available between them. To export or migrate data from HugeGraph, see the SeaTunnel Source export and migration guide.

Version requirement: This guide targets SeaTunnel 3.0+. All examples use the mappings configuration available in SeaTunnel 3.0+.

With HugeGraph Helm, you can directly enable the built-in SeaTunnel engine. That path includes the pre-configured connector, runtime environment, and same-release credential references. This page covers job mappings for external data sources.
